483-2760-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
483-2760-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
483-2760-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

3755-4770-5301-7175.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2374-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2374-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3112-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3112-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-1636-7517-7875.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Aqueous Aria using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-7517-7875.description:
Cast Aqueous Aria using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Campus Composer.
When Campus Composer enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2626-3518-4986.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3147-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3147-4231-7810.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2178-6797-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

215-5711-7296.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7606.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2557-3899-4241-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3558-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4222-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-3574-4222-6774.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3574-4222-6774.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4222-6774.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

997-4484-4871-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-4484-4871-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
997-4484-4871-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-4484-4871-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

191-1742-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-1742-6625.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5500-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5500-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2423-2440-5663--108.notablePrerequisites: You control a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
2423-2440-5663--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Bounding Krasis token.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Bounding Krasis token.
Repeat.
2423-2440-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Bounding Krasis.

152-1418-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-1418-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1274-2034-3490-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-5789.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4475-5605.manaNeeded: {6}{B}{B} at most plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
4475-5605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a life total of 40 or higher.
4475-5605.description:
Cast Torgaar either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at most {6}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Torgaar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose an amount of life equal to their life total minus 20.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

1368-1396-3883.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
A player has at least four cards in hand.
1368-1396-3883.description:
Cast Whispering Madness from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw at least four cards, then create that many Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Widespread Thieving

736-947-1132-1305.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving and Copy Enchantment trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

232-2034-4316-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Urabrask on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

141-313-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-5147.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1889-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Simian Simulacrum.
Simian Simulacrum enters the battlefield, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1124-2793-4659-4772-5089.manaNeeded: {2} on the first turn, with {7} available each subsequent turn
1124-2793-4659-4772-5089.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, and causes you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing any artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, revealing Ugin's Nexus from exile and putting it into your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1548-4897-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1548-4897-5256.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Port Razer, causing target player to mill cards equal to Port Razer's power.
Repeat.

1322-3638-4875.description:
Cast Turntimber Ranger by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Turntimber Ranger enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
2/2 Wolf creature token enters the battlefield triggering Turntimber Ranger, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-1976-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2397-3634-3821.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax minus {1} if applicable.
2397-3634-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Venser either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Venser enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-4222.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Jegantha.
Repeat.

3430-4449-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Hateflayer.
3430-4449-4474.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {2}{R} and untapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
